acceptanceCriteria: The issue's three-project repro produces a discovery receipt instead of a stale-listing refusal, with a regression test.

An omission a static grep does not explain is still refused, and a dynamic grep records the omission with explicit uncertainty; each case has a focused test and numbered requirements in the owning spec.
body:
Source: GitHub beamfall/corvint#790.

## Observed
`corvint affected discovery --playwright-config PATH --playwright-list FILE` refuses a complete, unfiltered live listing with unsupported-playwright-discovery ("listing omits project ... the listing is stale or filtered") when a Playwright project declares grep/grepInvert. Playwright applies project grep at list time, so non-matching tests never appear under that project.

## Repro
Three projects sharing one testDir: main {grepInvert:/@tagged/}, alt-a {grep:/@tagged/}, alt-b {grep:/@tagged/}; most spec files have no @tagged test. Unfiltered `playwright test --list --reporter=json` then discovery exits 2, no receipt.

## Expected
An omission that the project's grep/grepInvert explains is accepted as that project's selection; the stale-listing refusal stays for projects without grep and for omissions the pattern does not explain; a non-static grep records the omission with explicit uncertainty.
